name: adapt_renamed_symbol_java_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time Area.java's own text contains 'circleArea' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then MathUtils.square is RENAMED to MathUtils.sq under it
prompts: MathUtils.java declares a public final class MathUtils with a public static double square(double x). Create Area.java with a public final class Area containing a public static double circleArea(double r) that returns 3.14159 * MathUtils.square(r).
MathUtils.square has just been renamed to MathUtils.sq. Update Area.java to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name square).

disruptions.description: MathUtils.square renamed to MathUtils.sq, triggered reactively once Area.java's first draft appeared
